187.subject: Botany
187.text: Assertion : Specialization of cells is advantageous for the organism. Reason : It increases the operational efficiency of an organism.
options: If both the assertion and reason are true and reason is a correct explanation of the assertion.
If both assertion and reason are true but assertion is not a correct explanation of the assertion.
If the assertion is true but the reason is false.
If both assertion and reason are false.
187.sol: Specialization of cells into tissue, organ and organ systems is advantageous for the organism. It increases the operational efficiency through division of labour which avoids duplication of work.

2025.subject: Zoology
2025.text: Which vitamin is associated with the maintenance of bone density?
2025.sol: Bone density is the amount of bone mineral present in bone tissue. The higher the bone mineral content, the denser the bones are. Several vitamins are important to bone health. Vitamin B ₁₂ has an effect on bone building cells. The low levels of B ₁₂ result in the higher risk of osteoporosis in both men and women and thus results in lower bone density. Vitamin C is essential for the formation of collagen, the foundation that bone mineralization is built on. Increased levels of vitamin C results in greater bone dens

2244.text: Contraceptive oral pills help in birth control by
2244.sol: Oral contraceptive pills inhibit ovulation and implantation. They have to be taken daily for 21 days starting within the first five days of menstrual cycle. After a gap of 7 days, it has to be repeated.

3854.subject: Chemistry
3854.text: Steam distillation process cannot be used for purifying which of the following?
3854.sol: Steam distillation is the simplest method, which is used to isolate materials that are temperature sensitive like organic compounds. It is applicable at a low boiling point in order to avoid decomposition. It cannot be applicable in the purification of those organic compounds that are water soluble, non-volatile in steam, vapour pressure low and contains volatile impurities. p -nitrophenol is steam volatile, thus it cannot be used for purifying by steam distillation.

44974.subject: Botany
44974.text: Intermediate community between pioneer and climax communities is called
44974.sol: The first biotic community which develops in a bare area is called pioneer community. Climax community is the stable, self perpetuating and final biotic community that develops at the end of biotic succession. The various biotic communities that develop during biotic succession are termed as seral or transitional communities.

45141.subject: Botany

45141.sol: The heterotrichous thallus is shown by Ectocarpus. It is a filamentous marine brown alga which has both upright and prostrate regions. Such a growth is called heterotrichous.

45237.subject: Botany
45237.text: A mature pollen grain of Pinus has
45237.sol: In Pinus, the microspore nucleus divides by a periclinal wall and forms a very small prothallial cell and large central cell. The central cell cuts off a second prothallial cell and antheridial cell. The nucleus of the antheridial cell divides to form generative cell and tube cell. Thus, the pollen grain of Pinus is shed at four cell stage when it consists of two vegetative prothallial cells, a generative cell and a tube cell.

47158.subject: Zoology
47158.text: A woman with two genes (one on each X -chromosome) for haemophilia and one gene for colour blindness on the X-chromosome marries a normal man. How will the progeny be?
options: All sons and daughters are haemophilic and colourblind
50 % haemophilic colourblind sons and 50 % haemophilic sons
47158.sol: Haemophilia and colour blindness both are recessive X-linked traits. They express in males when present in single copy (heterozygous) but in females, they express only when present in homozygous condition. Results (a) 50 % sons are colourblind and haemophilic. (b) 50 % sons are haemophilic only. (c) 50 % daughters are carrier for colour blindness and haemophilia. (d) 50 % daughters are carrier for haemophilia only.

47271.subject: Biology
47271.text: Aldosterone from adrenal cortex stimulates the reabsorption of water and Na ^+ from ______.
options: Ascending limb of loop of Henle
Descending limb of loop of Henle
47271.sol: Aldosterone is a mineralocorticoid hormone secreted by the adrenal cortex. It acts mainly on the distal parts of the nephron, specifically the Distal Convoluted Tubule (DCT) and the collecting duct. It stimulates the conditional reabsorption of Na ^+ and water from the filtrate in the DCT, which helps in maintaining the blood pressure, blood volume, and osmotic balance. It also stimulates the excretion of K ^+ and phosphate ions. Answer: Distal Convoluted Tubule (DCT)

71016.sol: The trachea is a straight tube extending up to the mid-thoracic cavity. It is supported by incomplete cartilaginous rings (C-shaped), not complete rings. 71842.sol: Chlorination of alkanes is a free radical substitution reaction. The initiation step involves the breaking of the Cl-Cl bond in the presence of ultraviolet light ( h ) or heat. 79588.sol: Eubacteria are the true bacteria, which lack a nucleus and membrane-bound organelles like mitochondria, chloroplast, etc. Bacteria are cosmopolitan. 101428.text: A student incorrectly uses the approximate formula g' = g (1 - 2h R ) to calculate the acceleration due to gravity at a height h above the earth's surface (where R is the radius of the earth). At a particular height, this formula predicts that the weight of a body will become zero. What is the true weight of the body at this height, if its weight on the surface of the earth is W ?
101428.sol: The approximate formula for acceleration due to gravity at a height h is g' = g (1 - 2h R ) . According to the question, this formula predicts zero weight, so g' = 0 . 1 - 2h R = 0 h = R 2 The true acceleration due to gravity at a height h is given by the exact formula: g_h = g (1 + h R )^2 Substituting h = R 2 : g_h = g (1 + 1 2 )^2 = g ( 3 2 )^2 = 4g 9 Therefore, the true weight of the body is W_ true = m g_h = 4 9 mg = 4W 9 . Answer: 4W 9

118315.sol: C - Br bond is weaker than C - Cl bond, therefore, alkyl bromide (II) reacts faster than alkyl chlorides, (III) and (IV). Since CH ₂= CH - is electron withdrawing therefore, CH ₂ has more +ve charge on III than on IV. In other words, nucleophilic attack occurs faster on III than on IV. Further, since Williamson synthesis occurs by S _ N 2 mechanism, therefore, due to steric hindrance alkyl bromide (I) is the least reactive. Thus, the decreasing order of reactivity is II > III > IV > I.

Just after world war II, among the several efforts to put radioisotopes to beneficial use, the work of Melvin Calvin is exemplary. effective pumping of CO ₂ into bundle sheath cells
RUBISCO in CO ₄ plants has higher affinity for CO ₂
125747.sol: The fixation of CO ₂ in C ₄ plants takes place in two places and by two different organic compounds. Phosphoenol pyruvate (PEP) is found in mesophyll cells which primarily fixes atmospheric CO ₂ into oxaloacetic acid (4C). RUBISCO is present in bundle sheath cells where final fixation of CO ₂ in hexose sugars takes place. CO ₂ is primarily fixed by PEP carboxylase because this enzyme has greater affinity to CO ₂ than RUBISCO.

129388.sol: When an impulse arrives at the synaptic knob of the axon, it depolarizes the presynaptic membrane and increases its permeability to calcium ions ( Ca ²⁺ ) . Ca ²⁺ ions from the synaptic cleft pass into the synaptic knob via voltagegated channels. Sudden rise in the cytosolic concentration of Ca ²⁺ , causes the release of a chemical, called neurotransmitter substance, from small synaptic vesicles present there into the synaptic cleft by exocytosis through the presynaptic membrane.

135384.text: According to the Verhulst-Pearl logistic growth model, the rate of change in population size is given by the equation dN dt = rN ( K-N K ) . When the population density ( N ) exactly reaches the carrying capacity ( K ) of the habitat, what will be the value of the environmental resistance term ( K-N K ) and the corresponding population growth rate ( dN dt ) respectively?
135384.sol: In the Verhulst-Pearl logistic growth equation, dN dt = rN ( K-N K ) , the term ( K-N K ) represents the environmental resistance. When the population density ( N ) reaches the carrying capacity ( K ), we substitute N = K into the term: K-K K = 0 K = 0 Consequently, the population growth rate becomes: dN dt = rN 0 = 0 This mathematical boundary condition indicates that the population size has stabilized and is no longer growing, which corresponds to the asymptote of the logistic growth curve. Answer: 0 and Zero

95639.sol: Methanobacillus (methanogen) occurs in marshes and also in dung. It produces CH 4 gas under anaerobic condition and is utilised in gobar gas plant.

96025.subject: Botany
96025.text: The walls of sieve tubes develop into sieve plates together getting associated with _________.
96025.sol: The plasmodesmata act as channels between the cell walls of adjacent plant cells. They are mainly involved in transport and cell to cell recognition. Structurally, the sieve tubes wall is dispersed with plasmodesmata and are grouped together. Later, these areas of the tube walls and plasmodesmata develop into sieve plates.

96272.subject: Botany
96272.text: A cell during the equational division of genetic material will show which of the following events? I. interphase II. anaphase III. cytokinesis
96272.sol: Mitosis is one of the two divisional phase in cell-cycle. It occurs after interphase and is succeeded by cytokinesis (cytoplasm division). Mitosis has prophase, metaphase, anaphase and telophase as the stages of karyokinesis in the same order.

96313.subject: Botany
96313.text: Division of centromere is absent in
96313.sol: During anaphase I chromosomal pairs separates and chromosomes starts moving towards opposite poles. This separation of chromosomal pair is called disjunction and it results in reduction in number of chromosome to half. Centromere splits and chromatids are separated during anaphase of mitosis and anaphase II of meiosis.

96803.subject: Botany
96803.text: Which one of the following is not a nitrogen fixing organism?
96803.sol: Certain prokaryotic organisms are capable fixing nitrogen available in the air and reduce it to ammonia. They have presence of an enzyme called nitrogenase which helps in reduction of nitrogen to ammonia. This process is called biological nitrogen fixation and the organisms are called nitrogen fixers. These nitrogen fixers could be free living or symbiotic. The examples of these free living microbes are Azotobacter, Rhodospirillum, Anabaena, Nostoc, etc. Pseudomonas are not nitrogen fixing bacterias.

96952.subject: Botany
96952.text: Which one of the following statements is correct?
options: The seed in grasses is not endospermic.
A proteinaceous aleurone layer is present in maize grain.
A sterile pistil is called a staminode.
96952.sol: In monocotyledonous endospermic seeds, the endosperm is surrounded by proteinaceous one-cell thick layer, called the aleurone layer. The cells of aleurone layer are filled with proteinaceous aleurone grains which play an important role at the time of germination.

97103.subject: Botany
97103.text: How many plants in the list given below have composite fruits that develop from an inflorescence? Walnut, poppy, radish, fig, pineapple, apple, tomato, mulberry
97103.sol: Composite fruits or multiple fruits are the fruits formed from the entire inflorescence of the fruiting bodies rather than from a single flower. These fruiting bodies form one single fruiting mass when fused while development eg: pineapple. There are two kinds of composite fruits categorized on basis of inflorescence, sorosis where the fruit develops from the ovaries of several flowers eg: mulberry and synchronous, when the fruit develops from the flowers which are grown in the hollow fleshy stalk of inflorescence

97292.subject: Botany
97292.text: Which of the following don't occur naturally?
97292.sol: Auxins are one the growth promoters found in plants. These are mostly produces by the apical parts of roots and stems and from there move to different parts of plant as per need. Indole-3-acetic acid(IAA) and indole butyric acid(IBA) are produced by plant and have been isolated as natural auxins. NAA (naphthalene acetic acid) and 2, 4-D (2, 4-dichlorophenoxyacetic) are synthetic auxins that have been used in agricultural and horticultural practices.

306647.text: Examine the following statements about a thermocouple. (A) The neutral temperature is independent of the cold junction temperature. (B) The inversion temperature is independent of the cold junction temperature.
options: Both statements A and B are false
Statement A is true but B is false
Statement B is true but A is false
Both statements A and B are true
306647.sol: The neutral temperature T_n is a characteristic property of the pair of metals used in the thermocouple and is independent of the cold junction temperature T_c . The inversion temperature T_i depends on the cold junction temperature T_c according to the relation T_i - T_n = T_n - T_c , which gives T_i = 2T_n - T_c . Thus, statement A is true and statement B is false.

306655.subject: Physics
306655.text: In a Coolidge tube, the energy of a characteristic X-ray photon is derived from
options: the kinetic energy of the free electrons in the target
the kinetic energy of the impinging electron
the kinetic energy of the ions in the target
an atomic transition within the target
306655.sol: Characteristic X-rays are produced when an inner-shell electron of a target atom is knocked out by a high-energy incident electron, creating a vacancy in the inner shell. An electron from a higher energy level of the target atom then transitions to fill this vacancy. The energy of the emitted characteristic X-ray photon is exactly equal to the difference in energy between these two atomic levels. Therefore, the energy of a characteristic X-ray photon is derived from an atomic transition within the target.

6a7a1ff8ab0446f16ccc4487.text: Consider the following sequence of reactions: Ethylbenzene [ (ii) H ₃ O ^+] (i) KMnO ₄ , KOH, P SOCl ₂ Q H ₂ , Pd/BaSO ₄ R The total number of hydrogen atoms in one molecule of the final product R is _______.
6a7a1ff8ab0446f16ccc4487.sol: (i) Ethylbenzene undergoes side-chain oxidation with alkaline KMnO ₄ followed by acidification to form benzoic acid (Compound P). (ii) Benzoic acid reacts with SOCl ₂ to form benzoyl chloride (Compound Q). (iii) Benzoyl chloride undergoes Rosenmund reduction with H ₂ and Pd/BaSO ₄ to form benzaldehyde (Compound R). The chemical formula of benzaldehyde is C ₆ H ₅ CHO (or C ₇ H ₆ O ). Therefore, the total number of hydrogen atoms in one molecule of R is 5 + 1 = 6 . Answer: 6
